Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual square PNG ability icon for Mysteries Above, matching the approved Fool, Door and Sun sets. Full-canvas icon only, no outside presentation margins, sheet, atlas or montage. High-quality disciplined PIXEL ART: 32x32 logical-pixel sprite enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor blocks, broad clusters, stepped shading, clearly visible square pixels. Readable distinct silhouette at 15x15 UI size, interesting at large size. No painterly texture, 3D, smooth gradients or anti-aliasing. Simple THIN neutral silver gunmetal square bevel on canvas edges, light upper/left and charcoal lower/right, one dark inset; match existing common frames, no ornate corners. Nearly black interior #151118 with plenty of negative space. JUSTICIAR primary palette exact #EBC38E (235,195,142): pale champagne, warm sand-gold and antique brass shading, ivory #FFF3DA highlights; this is warmer and less lemon-yellow than Sun, NOT monochrome orange. Primary champagne must dominate brightest colored clusters, roughly two thirds of colored light. Harmonious coherent secondary clusters chosen for actual mechanism/material: slate steel, burgundy leather, smoky violet spirits, copper, tiny teal or ember accents; never rainbow speckles. Strong contrast and controlled local glow, no excessive bloom. No text, letters, digits, writing, readable runes, UI panels, religious crosses, watermark or logo. Each ability has its own composition and visual purpose.
